a.definition: used before a singular countable noun when referring to one person or thing that is not specifically identified

an.definition: used before a singular countable noun beginning with a vowel sound when the person or thing is not specifically identified

in.definition: inside a place, area, or period of time

or.definition: used to connect alternatives or choices

be.definition: to exist, occur, or have a particular state or quality

are.definition: a present-tense form of the verb 'be', used with you, we, they, and plural subjects

at.definition: used to show a particular place, point, time, or activity

as.definition: used to describe a role, comparison, manner, or situation

was.definition: the past-tense form of 'be' used with I, he, she, and it

can.definition: used to say that someone or something is able to do something

us.definition: the object form of 'we', used for the speaker and one or more other people

has.definition: the third-person singular present form of 'have'

more.definition: a greater amount, number, or degree

about.definition: on the subject of something; also used to mean approximately

the.definition: used before a noun to refer to a particular person or thing that is already known or identified

of.definition: used to show belonging, relationship, amount, or what something is about

and.definition: used to join words or parts of a sentence

to.definition: used to show direction, destination, or the person affected; also used before a verb to form the infinitive

for.definition: used to show purpose, benefit, intended recipient, or length of time

on.definition: in contact with a surface; also used for dates, devices, and topics

that.definition: used to point to a specific person, thing, idea, or clause

by.definition: used to show the agent, means, or nearness of something

this.definition: used to point to a person or thing that is near or has just been mentioned

with.definition: used to show being together, having something, or using something

you.definition: the person or people being spoken or written to

it.definition: used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea already mentioned

from.definition: used to show the starting point, origin, or source of something

your.definition: belonging to or connected with the person or people being spoken to

have.definition: to own, hold, or experience something; also used as an auxiliary verb

will.definition: used to talk about the future or to show willingness

we.definition: used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people

if.definition: used to introduce a condition or possibility

my.definition: belonging to or connected with the speaker

free.definition: costing nothing; also not controlled, limited, or imprisoned

but.definition: used to introduce a contrast or exception

our.definition: belonging to or connected with the speaker and one or more other people

do.definition: to perform an action or activity; also used as an auxiliary verb in questions and negatives

no.definition: used to mean not any, or to give a negative answer

they.definition: used to refer to people, animals, or things already mentioned

he.definition: used to refer to a male person or animal already mentioned

up.definition: toward a higher place or position; also used in many everyday phrasal verbs

may.definition: used to say that something is possible or to ask for or give permission

what.definition: used to ask for information about something

which.definition: used to ask about or refer to one or more things from a group

their.definition: belonging to or connected with the people or things already mentioned

out.definition: away from the inside or away from a place; also used in many everyday phrasal verbs

see.definition: to notice or become aware of something with your eyes; also to understand

so.definition: used to show degree, result, or agreement

his.definition: belonging to or connected with a male person or animal already mentioned

when.definition: used to ask or talk about the time at which something happens

here.definition: in, at, or to this place

get.definition: to receive, obtain, become, or arrive

online.definition: connected to or available through the internet

first.definition: coming before all others in order, time, or importance

would.definition: used to talk about a possible or imagined situation, or a polite request

how.definition: used to ask or talk about the way or manner in which something happens

me.definition: the object form of 'I', used for the speaker

these.definition: used to point to people or things that are near or have just been mentioned

click.definition: to press a button on a computer mouse or similar device

its.definition: belonging to or connected with a thing, animal, or idea already mentioned

like.definition: to find someone or something pleasant or enjoyable; also used to mean 'similar to'

than.definition: used after a comparative adjective or adverb to introduce the second part of a comparison

find.definition: to discover or locate someone or something

back.definition: in or toward a previous place, position, or time

just.definition: only; also a very short time ago

over.definition: above or across something; also used to mean finished

into.definition: to the inside or inner part of a place, container, or state

re.definition: used especially in writing to mean 'about' or 'regarding'; also used as a prefix meaning 'again'

go.definition: to move or travel to a place

buy.definition: to get something by paying money for it

make.definition: to create, produce, or cause something

should.definition: used to say what is right, expected, or advisable

post.definition: a message published online, or letters and parcels sent by mail

her.definition: used to refer to a female person or animal as an object or to show possession

add.definition: to put something together with something else to increase the number, size, or amount

please.definition: used as a polite word when asking for something

after.definition: later than a particular time, event, or order

best.definition: of the highest quality; better than all others

then.definition: at that time; next in order or result

good.definition: of high quality, pleasant, or morally right

well.definition: in a good or satisfactory way

where.definition: used to ask or talk about a place or position

high.definition: great in height, amount, or level

through.definition: from one side or end of something to the other; also by means of

links.definition: connections between web pages or related things

she.definition: used to refer to a female person or animal already mentioned

years.definition: more than one year; periods of twelve months

very.definition: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb

read.definition: to look at and understand written words

de.definition: a particle used in some names and phrases from French or Spanish, often meaning 'of' or 'from'

does.definition: the third-person singular present form of 'do'

under.definition: in a lower position than something; also controlled or covered by something

general.definition: affecting or involving all or most people, places, or things; not detailed or special

full.definition: containing or holding as much as possible; complete

know.definition: to have information or understanding about something in your mind

could.definition: used to talk about ability or possibility in the past, or polite requests

united.definition: joined together for a common purpose

real.definition: actually existing; not imaginary or false

there.definition: in, at, or to that place; also used to introduce a sentence about existence
